decisions.reason: The DPA management tool fits the firm's compliance direction and agency focus, had positive feedback, and still has its own page, so it is cheap to keep as a differentiator.
It is the flagship management platform, shown on the home page and central to the firm's agency-focused strategy.
Configurable managed hosting is core revenue close to the established offer and remained presented on its own page.
Extended PHP security support meets agency needs for legacy projects and fits the security promise, though such offerings can be phased out or folded into plans as PHP versions age.
